agnostic_oa_w2046916388_uniqueness_purit.interpretation: There are three separate identification questions: dual payoffs determine how surplus is divided, the primal coupling determines who matches with whom, and disintegration determines whether each buyer's conditional partner law is a point mass. Unique marginal derivatives may leave payoff constants free; unique payoffs may leave several optimal couplings; and a unique coupling may still have branched conditional support. Treating these as one notion of equilibrium uniqueness loses the obstruction each theorem addresses.
